title: Last record; hearing the sections; not a songwriter
summary: Scott last recorded with Alex Jackson and loved hearing a band.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: When was the last time you made a record? Or appeared on a record?
Well, the last that I can recall was Alex Jackson. In Alex Jackson's band. Because I'd (unintelligible) before them, but after that there wasn't any -- I wasn't with the record-making --
Uh-huh. So that's been a very long time, that you haven't made a record.

That's right. I wasn't particular about it, because it happened -- most singing and like that, to tell you the truth, what I like about bands, I like to hear a band play. I like that music. I like it because in my mind, I could hear the different sections. And I liked to hear what each section was playing and all like that. Walk in the street and still hear that song in my mind.
It's a funny thing. And I would go home, and I used
to take my pen and write down the position of each man on the band, and how he was sitting, and just look at it like that, then I could hear that number they played.
Well, see, it was all music with me. Singers came in there and it did something to the music. I don't know. The band had to stop and the singers had to come in there and (unintelligible).
Me? No, I wasn't a writer. I liked to play them, I loved to play. I didn't go in for writing myself, no. Let me play. I want to play. That's all I wanted to do.
